subject: STABLE lowering-opus 06:2x: render state setters implemented/refused + depth/stencil test & writes on the generic path (tile-buffer, host-only)
body:
Hashes: bridge.c 10cefe5e .h 39b9db7d; render.c fb6ad35a .h da17d2f5; nord2_render_pass.inc 0a6e5ffa; blend_state.c c16b7e40 .h 55052195; ws_selector_compat.inc f3e00ca6; compositor_submit.inc a5d8880e; render_encoder.inc 8a615e42; compute_frontend.m 07857810; draw_reorder.inc 213a5fda; air_bridge.rs 02c3f502; tests bridge f79a91ef render 7c4095aa; workers/render/host_test_vs_texture.py 3ac779c3.
(1) Setters (ws_selector_compat.inc): setBlendColor -> BLEND.blend_constant on the generic draw (blend_state.c now admits Metal factors 11..14 = MALI_BLEND_OPERAND_C_CONSTANT; one homogeneous scalar, unorm targets, Mesa pan_pack_blend_constant; non-homogeneous / float targets / SourceAlphaSaturated refused; Metal default colour 0 when unset). setDepthClipMode Clamp -> DEPTH_STENCIL depth_cull off + clamp BOUNDS (Mesa v9), refused on non-generic paths. setDepthBias / setStencilReferenceValue / front-back -> stored, used by the depth/stencil path below. setVisibilityResultMode != Disabled -> explicit TEGU_INVALID (passes refuse visibility buffers). NOTE: pipelines with blend-colour factors are only created after the Rust lib is rebuilt with my air_bridge.rs RenderBlend::apply hunk (bound 9 -> 11..14; 10 still refused): integration 'candidate provenance' fails until that rebuild + receipt (root).
(2) Depth/stencil: the pass already admits only Store=DontCare depth/stencil attachments, so depth/stencil lives in the tile buffer: FB z_internal_format/z_clear/s_clear, no ZS writeback/preload; DEPTH_STENCIL from MTLDepthStencilState (compare, write, stencil ops remapped Metal->Mali, masks, refs) + depth bias (Mesa x2 for unorm). A job Clear/DontCare-starts unless an earlier job of the pass wrote depth/stencil; then it continues (load 1) and must share that JM job (compositor batch keyed by pass + zs; bridge refuses a lone continue -> command error, never a re-clear). Depth Load passes and non-generic paths stay refused (-14). D32F+S8 separate attachments map to one D32 tile plane. Tests: render oracle (FB/DS packing), bridge (continuity rules), harness (stencil test 2 draws -> ONE JM job chain 2; unbatched -> status 5), blend colour/clip/visibility frontend checks.
Gates 05:55-06:05 + fixes: iOS -Werror x3 + ARM64 bridge/render rc=0 (re-run 06:2x rc=0); render harness PASS; CA PF0/PF1 PASS; run_host_tests 61 PASS to the strict link step (known NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN); integration 939: only candidate provenance (Rust edit, needs rebuild) + known CA stride; bridge test 19 PASS x3; render oracle PASS. Harness re-run after a final standalone-test guard is queued behind the lease.
Not done: #8 remaining pass merging (next). Device: nothing claimed.
